issues.summary: Migrate Argo token client to Auth API v2
issues.content:
Issue: ARGO-250
Summary: Migrate Argo token client to Auth API v2
Type: Story
Status: To Do
Assignee: Ravi Kulkarni
Reporter: Tara Bose
Labels: migration, authentication, breaking-change

Description:
AUTH-900 removes POST /v1/auth on 2026-10-01. Update Argo Orchestrator to request workflow tokens from POST /v2/auth. Until src/token_client.py changes, Argo remains an Auth API v1 consumer.
